entities.summary: Hong Kong is a sovereign nation in East Asia, Asia. Its capital is N/A (city-territory; Central is de facto centre). Official languages include Chinese (Cantonese de facto), English. Government: Special Administrative Region of PRC (executive-led). Population: approximately 7.5 million. Area: 1,114 km². Comprehensive index for Hong Kong covering prehistoric Yuet/Baiyue settlements, Han-era inclusion in Nanyue, Song dynasty refugees, Portuguese contact 1514, Qing era, Opium War and Treaty of Nanking 1842 (Hong Kong Island ceded), Convention of Peking 1860 (Kowloon), New Territories lease 1898, Japanese occupation 1941-1945, post-war economic miracle, 1967 riots, handover to China 1997 (One Country Two Systems), 2014 Umbrella Movement, 2019 protests, and National Security Law 2020.
